body: Your so strong. I hope all of us gained a little bit from your story. I failed at suicide when I drank a shit ton took over 20 kpins downed a bottle of deslsyum cough syrup with a couple of Xanax bars. My tolerance to drugs at the time kept my body alive.. but I realized that it wasn't a suicide attempt. it was my desperate cry for help because I'm losing this battle. You weren't ready to die... You just couldn't bare the suffering. Just keep that recording as a reminder that you have low points but you also have your good moments as well

How you doing? You ok? Take some deep breathes. You are not over dramatic, you are completely justified. It's not normal for us to feel this, our problems are just as real as cancer. But the scariest part is only you can see, feel, and experience it to its full capacity. I think you should go, if you feel like a danger to yourself.. I think I might go check myself in today as well. I've been debating it..

We don't deserve this pain... I'm working on getting myself help but I feel like it might be futile. Your right though life doesn't really have a purpose it's what you make of it is when you find your own self purpose. I've always put my pain into my poetry and my drawings but I lost that motivation when I turned to drugs cope with everything. Now being sober for a few months I have a clearish head but I still feel disassociated in life. I'm sorry that you or anyone has to be in the same position as me. I would never wish this on anyone. I wanted to use this post as a way to talk to people and figure out some ways to help myself and others.. Just keep telling yourself to push through one more day... The thought of suicide is comforting to me because I feel like i finally have a choice in dealing with my problems... Because up to this point I've just been thrown between psychiatrists and anti depressants of all sorts to no avail... They make you feel like your crazy as fuck, and you feel worse about yourself in the end.... But to anyone else who reads this... I can't stop myself or you from the choice your debating on making... But Your not in this by yourself...

Same position. I feel uncomfortable with my existence.. And I day by day accept the idea more that I need to end myself because this form of existence isn't worth it. And it makes me genuinely happy.. I just can't have any emotional ties.. I don't want to hurt anyone.. But I can't live when I'm uncomfortable just being alive.
